message.content: According to the discussions, GromHellscream suggests adding lanterns or string lights to the garden area to brighten it in the evening. GromHellscream believes this would create a "cozy atmosphere during the evenings" and also make it suitable for community gatherings. Additionally, GromHellscream proposes that the garden should have a magical feel at night, suggesting lanterns and lights could indeed make the garden "magical."
